retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait integrated into a stained-glass grid with vibrant floral motifs and expressive brushwork.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central high-contrast portrait with purple-tinted skin and yellow hair, set against a chaotic background of vibrant flowers and abstract brushstrokes, all partitioned by a thick black irregular grid resembling stained glass lead cames.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated behind and within a black grid
High-contrast purple portrait against warm floral background
Organic floral shapes vs. rigid geometric grid
Expressive painterly textures vs. photographic subject
coreInvariants: Vibrant red and white floral accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central portrait, medium-close up, looking upward and slightly right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The purple face of the subject serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central face upward along the grid lines to the floral clusters in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and maximalist with overlapping textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and black provide the structural and tonal foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red and white flowers provide high-key contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow hair and green leaf accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high contrast; deep blacks against luminous, glowing colors.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weights with sharp terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are exaggerated to fit a narrow vertical column

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a black vertical banner

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, clean sans-serif for secondary metadata to contrast the expressive main script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, painterly energy of the artwork

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a neo-expressionist painting featuring a central portrait of a man with purple skin and yellow hair, looking up. Overlay a thick, irregular black grid like stained glass. Fill the grid cells with vibrant red roses, white lilies, and abstract colorful brushstrokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical black banner in the top right corner. Inside the banner, place white hand-lettered vertical script with jagged, expressive strokes.

verificationChecks: Is the grid thick and black?
Is the portrait skin tone distinctly purple?
Are the flowers vibrant and painterly?
Is the text vertically oriented in the top right?

mustRedesign: Avoid literal transcription of artist names
Do not use standard digital fonts for the main script
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple portrait is the clear focal point
Verify the grid lines appear as physical dividers
Check that the floral elements feel integrated, not just pasted on
Confirm the color palette is high-saturation
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Stained Glass Grid + Neo-Expressionist Florals + Purple/Black/Red Palette
